isNotASecondLedger: a custody view over the work view's own source re-derivation. It introduces no status, no denominator and no ownership. It records, per family, the exact member to materialize, the digest that proves it, and where it must land.
matchRule: a member matches only when its recomputed SHA-256 equals the digest pinned in the asset identity and its byte length agrees. A filename, a path convention or a manifest claim never counts as a match.
